By virtue of the authority vested in me as President of the United States of 
America, in order to correct a typographical error, it is hereby ordered that the 
adjusted maximum scale of pay in the Section 4103 Schedule for Director of Nursing 
Service, as set forth in Schedule 3 of Executive Order No. 11941 of October 1, 1976, is 
amended by ehanging “ 2,611*” to read “ 52,611*” .

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: The sole clause corrects a typographical error by amending one figure of Schedule 3 of EO 11941. That is a self-executing amendment of another order: it was performed on issue, on the order's date 1976-10-25 (the order states no later effective date), and nothing remains for it to command afterwards. The corrected figure continued inside EO 11941 until section 4 of EO 12010 (September 28, 1977) superseded EO 11941; that later event is recorded as the end of the surviving consequence, not as this order's own end, and it is the formal disposition noted by the Federal Register catalog, the 1989 codification and the U.S. Code note.

research_rationale:
EO 11943 (October 25, 1976; 41 FR 47213) is a one-paragraph order that corrects a typographical error in Schedule 3 of EO 11941 of October 1, 1976: it amends the adjusted maximum scale of pay in the Section 4103 Schedule for Director of Nursing Service by changing one figure. The held Federal Register original is read in full and has no other clause. The correction was made when the order issued on 1976-10-25; the corrected figure then lived inside EO 11941 until EO 12010 (September 28, 1977; 42 FR 52365, section 4) provided that EO 11941 is superseded. The three held records that mention the order agree: the Federal Register catalog and the 1989 codification both note it as amending EO 11941 and superseded by EO 12010, and the U.S. Code table in the note to 5 U.S.C. 5332 lists EO 11941 as amended by EO 11943 and superseded by EO 12010. Those notes are a disposition of the amended parent and are reconciled in the savings and earlier-end checks. No held source shows a later order reviving EO 11941. The recommended provisional status is no.

savings_residuals.reason: The only consequence of EO 11943 was the corrected pay figure inside Schedule 3 of EO 11941. Section 4 of EO 12010 (42 FR 52365, official Federal Register text) supersedes EO 11941, so that consequence ended with its parent; EO 12010 states no separate effective date for section 4, so the signing date 1977-09-28 is recorded, and its new schedules took effect October 1, 1977. No payment right, appointment or transfer arose from EO 11943 itself that outlives the pay schedule, and the bounded searches of the U.S. Code, the eCFR and the Federal Register disposition catalog show no later instrument reviving EO 11941 or its Schedule 3.
